title: Abeon Tenant DTO
description:
A client organisation (ADR-0016). Returned by `GET /api/v1/auth/tenants` as the list a user may switch between; the chrome renders it in the tenant switcher and posts the chosen `id` to `POST /api/v1/auth/tenant` (ADR-0017).

Deliberately thin: identity and display only. Roles and permissions are NOT here — they are per membership and arrive in the re-issued JWT, so a client can never derive its own authorisation from this list.

name.description: Display name, e.g. "Acme Sp. z o.o.".

slug.description: URL-safe identifier. Stable; suitable for deep links and logs.

logo_url.description: Optional organisation logo for the switcher.

current.description: True for the organisation the caller's token is currently scoped to. Populated by Auth on the list response; ignored on input.
